metadata.question: Was the number of fire detections in Pantanal, Brazil on June 11, 2024, greater than the number detected in any June from 2000 to 2023, as observed with MODIS Aqua?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Fire products - MODIS/006/MCD14ML (daily fire detections) - Date: June 11, 2024 vs all June months from 2000-2023 - Location: Pantanal, Brazil - need to define this biome boundary 2. Masking strategy: - Fire detection data doesn't need cloud masking - Filter by confidence levels if needed - Count fire detections (pixels or points) 3. Logic: - Count fires on June 11, 2024 - Count max fires from any single day in June 2000-2023 - Compare: if 2024 > historical max → A, else → B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no fires = valid zero), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Pantanal region (approximate boundary) const pantanal = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-58.5, -22.0], [-58.5, -16.0], [-55.0, -16.0], [-55.0, -22.0], [-58.5, -22.0]] ]); // 2. Load MODIS fire detection data const fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14ML'); // 3. Get fire count for June 11, 2024 const target_date = '2024-06-11'; const fires_2024 = fireCollection .filterDate(target_date, ee.Date(target_date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(pantanal); const size_2024 = fires_2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images on ${target_date}: ${size_2024}`); if (size_2024 === 0) { console.log('No fire data available for June 11, 2024'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Count fire detections in 2024 const fire_count_2024 = fires_2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fire detections on June 11, 2024: ${fire_count_2024}`); // 4. Get historical June fire counts (2000-2023) const years = []; for (let year = 2000; year <= 2023; year++) { years.push(year); } let max_historical = 0; let max_year = 0; let max_date = ''; for (const year of years) { const june_start = `${year}-06-01`; const june_end = `${year}-07-01`; const june_fires = fireCollection .filterDate(june_start, june_end) .filterBounds(pantanal); const daily_counts = []; for (let day = 1; day <= 30; day++) { const date_str = `${year}-06-${String(day).padStart(2, '0')}`; const day_fires = fireCollection .filterDate(date_str, ee.Date(date_str).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(pantanal); const count = day_fires.size().getInfo(); daily_counts.push(count); if (count > max_historical) { max_historical = count; max_year = year; max_date = date_str; } } } console.log(`Maximum historical June detections: ${max_historical} on ${max_date}`); console.log(`2024 detections: ${fire_count_2024}`); // 5. Compare and determine answer if (fire_count_2024 === null || fire_count_2024 === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result'); console.log('C3'); } else if (fire_count_2024 > max_historical) { console.log('2024 fire count exceeds historical maximum'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('2024 fire count does not exceed historical maximum'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
